sources.entry: Seedance Now - Multi-model text-to-video and image-to-video studio (Seedance 2.5, Kling 4.0, Wan 3.0), up to 30s at 1080p; independent, not affiliated with ByteDance. #freemium #video

summary.name: Seedance Now
summary.one_liner: Seedance Now is an independent, non-ByteDance-affiliated web platform for generating AI videos and images using Seedance, Kling, Wan, GPT Image and other models.
use_cases: Generate short AI video ads and product showcases
Animate a still image into a video
Make UGC-style review or unboxing videos
Produce multi-shot short films from one prompt
Generate AI images with GPT Image or Nano Banana
summary.what_it_does: The site is a web studio where users pick a video or image model, enter a prompt, optionally upload reference media, review a credit quote, and confirm generation. Listed models include Seedance 2.5, Seedance 2.0 (plus Fast and Mini variants), Kling 4.0, Wan 3.0, Veo 3.1, MiniMax H3, and image models such as GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana. The page says Seedance generates synchronized video and audio in one pass, with multilingual lip sync and camera-move control. Finished files and progress appear in a private workspace, and the page states no platform watermark is added to outputs. Guests can try image generation without signing in; video generation requires sign-in.
notable: Multi-model studio: Seedance, Kling, Wan, Veo, MiniMax and GPT Image in one credit balance
Claims no platform watermark on generated files
Explicitly independent of ByteDance, with an official-site disclaimer
Credit quote shown before each generation
caveats: Not affiliated with or operated by ByteDance; it is a third-party platform
Video generation requires sign-in and paid credits or an eligible unlimited benefit; guests get only a small image grant
Paid plans start at $14.90/month (300 credits); unlimited Seedance access is time-limited and subject to fair-use queues and cooldowns
